title: Carry out compulsory recalls of consumer goods
what: When the Minister issues a compulsory recall notice, the suppliers it names must take the actions it requires, such as recalling the goods.

sources.title: Competition and Consumer Act 2010
sources.quote: 123 Contents of a recall notice (1) A recall notice for the consumer goods may require one or more suppliers of the goods, or (if no such supplier is known to the responsible Minister who issued the notice) the regulator, to take one or more of the following actions: (a) recall the goods;

reach.condition: if it supplies consumer goods named in a compulsory recall notice
